title: A security flaw has been discovered in amirhamza05 Student-Management-System up to… (CVE-2026-135457)
description: A code injection vulnerability exists in the Installer Endpoint component of amirhamza05 Student-Management-System, specifically in the file page_action/install/install.php. The flaw is triggered by manipulation of the db_name argument and can be exploited remotely. The product uses a rolling release model, so exact affected versions are not specified. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 7.3, indicating high severity. Public exploit code has been released, but no official response or patch has been provided by the project at this time.
